title: Tell Your Story and Amplify Your Message - Creative Sign Making Workshop 1
description:
Join us in a Virtual Workshop where you will create a sign you love with a creative leader, Sara, and her co-leader for the workshop, Linda. Sara will lead you step by step through the sign making process. A supply list will be provided a week before the session so you can follow along and make a sign you will be proud to hold or wear. Each workshop will address one specific sign type. Attend all three so you have a sign collection to vary and/or share with friends. After the workshop series, perhaps you can lead a sign making session yourself with friends and family. The signs we create are a reflection of our resistance to this administration and our hopes and dreams for the future.

WORKSHOP I: MAKE A SIGN ON FOAM CORE WITH PAINT PENS AND ADD A GRAPHIC THAT EMOTES YOUR MESSAGE. In this workshop, you will choose a message that is most important to you. Sara will demonstrate techniques for lettering, drawing, or selecting a graphic that resonates with your message. If one of the graphics provided does not meet the moment, Linda will search online for you and send you the graphic to print/use. If you do not have a printer, we will show ways you can print the graphics and then apply.  After this workshop, you will have the techniques and tools to finish your sign and share at the next Sign Workshop or take a picture and send to CTD to share. You will leave the workshop with a draft you create of your sign message, graphic, and technique you will use to complete the sign. Sign up today!

title: No Kings/Kick Out the Clowns
description:
On June 14, our clown-king will honor himself with a four-mile military parade in our nation’s capitol. This tacky parade will cost taxpayers millions of dollars. Join us in protest of this ridiculous example of government waste.

WHEN: Saturday, June 14 from 5 - 8 PM

WHERE: TX Capitol Front Steps

BRING: EVERYONE. Bring your family and friends and your creative protest signs (No sticks longer than 12 inches are allowed by Capitol DPS including flag poles.)

Our grassroots street circus will turn satire into resistance and reclaim the big tent for democracy.

Women’s March KICK OUT THE CLOWNS: When you elect clowns, the country becomes a circus. 🤡 This will be a day of bold, creative actions in protest of the chaos that has been sown across the country. Together, we’ll set a national record for the most circuses held in a single day while we simultaneously refuse to celebrate a petty clown who desperately wants to be seen as strong. We won’t stop until we build the country we all deserve.

Indivisible’s NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption. The flag doesn’t belong to those that seek to destroy our country - it belongs to us. Join us to make history.

MOBILITY: We will be marching around the TX Capitol, not outside of Capitol grounds. If you have mobility concerns, you are welcome to stand firm at the front steps of the TX Capitol. Capitol bathrooms are ADA accessible.

DEETS: Bathrooms are available inside the Capitol. You will have to pass through a DPS security checkpoint to access bathrooms. Emergency water will be available on-site but please bring your own.

TRANSPORTATION & PARKING: CAPMETRO bus lines 1, 10, 103, 20, and 3 drop off near the Capitol, plan your trip. Please park at the Capitol Visitors Parking Garage (free for the first 2 hours), or park on the street in the neighborhoods west of the TX Capitol using the Park ATX app with discount codes: FREE15ATX1, FREE15ATX2

KEEP IN MIND: Soliciting donations and selling products is not allowed on Capitol grounds. We respect the DPS rules so that we can continue to have impactful mass mobilization efforts on OUR Capitol grounds!

SAFETY: We have a team of volunteers, legal observers, and street medics coming to this event. If you would like to volunteer for any of these teams, please use this form to contact us!

Veteran? We have a veterans arm of Hands Off Central TX. Plug in on-site to defend democracy, the constitution, and our first amendment rights. Email your interest to veterans@handsoffcentraltx.org

If your organization would like to partner with us to defend democracy, please email our lead wrangler (AKA Board President) president@handsoffcentraltx.org

Media disclaimer: There will be media and photos/videos of this event taken and shared on the internet, feel free to wear a mask for wellness or privacy reasons, and feel free to take your own photos and videos! Tag us: @handsoffcentraltx #handsofftx #nokings #kickouttheclown

Languages Disclaimer: ASL will be available for all speakers. Language interpretation for languages other than English will not be guaranteed at this event. 

Nonviolent Protest Disclaimer: Nobody from our organization will be provocative and we are not planning civil disobedience. We are utilizing our First Amendment right to protest and our right to lobby our representative government. We do everything in our power to protect the civil rights and physical safety of everyone at our events. We have yet to have any significant incidents of safety issues at any of our events.

By attending our events, you are implicitly agreeing that while you attend our event, you will respect the laws and constitution of the United States and State of Texas and not create or contribute to a safety issue or lawlessness for our attendees and neighbors. We protect our community and defend democracy - we do not put people at risk or threaten violence.

title: Town of Farmington Democratic Party Caucus
description:
# Caucus Meeting

## Meeting begins at 7:00
### Arrive early to check in 

### What is a caucus meeting? 
It is the opportunity for Democrats living in the Town of Farmington to select their candidates for this November's general election.

### What offices need candidates?
1. Supervisor (term 3 yr)
2. Council Member (2 offices, term 3 yrs)
3. Clerk (term 3 yrs)
4. Highway Superintendent (term 3 yrs)

### Who can participate?
Only registered voters enrolled in the Democratic Party and living in the Town of Farmington can participate in the meeting. 
Participation means: making motions, nominations and seconds, speaking in discussions and voting on potential candidates.

### Who can attend?
Any member of the public can attend this meeting.

title: Disappeared in America
description:
On Thursday, June 26th, we will show up
in front of the Buncombe County Courthouse to say: in America, we don’t let the government disappear people. That’s not who we are. 
In America, the government doesn’t get to grab people off the streets, skip the courtroom, and send them straight to a foreign prison. Disappeared in America is a national day of action to stand up for the rule of law and confront the Trump administration’s illegal abductions, detentions, and deportations. 
Americans believe in rule of law —and the courts are saying that due process is required. If a president can ignore the courts and disappear lawful residents, there is no limit to what can come next. President Trump has said he wants to abduct and deport U.S. citizens. If this isn’t stopped now, no one is safe.
There are two key focal points of this campaign: One will be to call on our local sheriff to refuse to cooperate with directives from ICE to engage in federal immigration enforcement. Also, Two, we are launching a national photo petition day where people will take photos with posters of those who have been disappeared and flood social media with the truth.
